brief:
A child in Gaza died from acute lead poisoning, prompting the Health Ministry to warn of widespread exposure risks among thousands of children, Shehab Wire reported. The death has drawn attention to hazardous conditions in displacement areas where damaged batteries are being repaired.

The ministry cited chronic lead poisoning as a threat to children in overcrowded camps. Health officials linked the exposure to informal battery repair operations conducted in close proximity to civilian populations seeking shelter.

title: Child dies of lead poisoning in Gaza displacement camps
